# pacs [![](reference/figures/pacs_logo.png)](https://github.com/polkas/pacs)

[![R build
status](https://github.com/polkas/pacs/workflows/R-CMD-check/badge.svg)](https://github.com/polkas/pacs/actions)
[![CRAN](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/pacs)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=pacs)
[![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/Polkas/pacs/branch/main/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/Polkas/pacs)

[**For more information please visit the pacs
website**](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/).

[**Functions
Reference**](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/index.html)

A set of tools that make life easier for developers and maintainers of R
packages.

- Validating the library, packages and `renv` lock files.
- Exploring complexity of a certain package like evaluating its size in
  bytes with dependencies.
- The shiny app complexity could be explored too.
- Assessing the life duration of a specific package version.
- Checking a CRAN package check page status for any errors and warnings.
- Retrieving a DESCRIPTION or NAMESPACE file for any package version.
- Reporting declared system requirements for a package and its
  dependencies.
- Comparing DESCRIPTION or NAMESPACE files between different package
  versions.
- Getting a list of all releases for a specific package.
- The Bioconductor is partly supported.

**An Internet connection is required to take full advantage of most of
the features.**

Bioconductor release dates and R-version mappings come from its official
configuration. Historical software-package counts are not provided by
that source, so the `Software packages` column returned by
[`bio_releases()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/bio_releases.md)
is `NA`.

**Almost all calls which requiring an Internet connection are cached
(for 30 minutes) by the `memoise` package, so the second invocation of
the same command (and arguments) is immediate. Restart the R session if
you want to clear cached data.**

## Installation

Development version:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("polkas/pacs")
```

CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("pacs")
```

## Examples

For more examples with descriptions please visit [**the walk-through
vignette**](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/articles/GettingStarted.html).

Validate the library:

``` r

pacs::lib_validate(
  checkred = list(
    scope = c("ERROR", "FAIL"),
    # by default all flavors
    flavors = NULL
  )
)
```

All package check statuses for all CRAN servers:

``` r

pacs::checked_packages()
```

All CRAN releases of a package:

``` r

pacs::pac_timemachine("dplyr")
```

Compare package DESCRIPTION file dependencies between versions:

``` r

pacs::pac_compare_versions("shiny", "1.0.0", "1.5.0")
```

Looking for heavy dependencies:

``` r

pacs::pac_deps_heavy("caret")
```

Report system requirements declared by an installed package and its
dependencies:

``` r

sysreqs <- pacs::pac_system_requirements("dplyr")
sysreqs |> unlist() |> unique()
```

# Package index

## Dependencies of R Package

- [`pac_deps()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_deps.md) :
  Package dependencies
- [`pac_deps_dev()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_deps_dev.md)
  : Package dependencies - developer perspective
- [`pac_deps_user()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_deps_user.md)
  : Package dependencies - user perspective
- [`pac_deps_heavy()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_deps_heavy.md)
  : Package direct dependencies and number of dependencies for each of
  them
- [`pac_deps_timemachine()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_deps_timemachine.md)
  : R CRAN package dependencies for a certain version or time point

## System Requirements

- [`pac_system_requirements()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_system_requirements.md)
  : Package system requirements

## Size of R Package

- [`pac_size()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_size.md) :
  Size of the package
- [`pac_true_size()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_true_size.md)
  : True size of the package

## CRAN Package Releases

- [`pac_timemachine()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_timemachine.md)
  : Package metadata for all releases

## NAMESPACE, NEWS and DESCRIPTION

- [`pac_description()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_description.md)
  : package DESCRIPTION file
- [`pac_namespace()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_namespace.md)
  : package NAMESPACE file
- [`pac_news()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_news.md) :
  Get NEWS for a package
- [`pac_compare_namespace()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_compare_namespace.md)
  : Compare NAMESPACE exports between specific CRAN packages versions
- [`pac_compare_versions()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_compare_versions.md)
  : Compare DESCRIPTION files dependencies between specific CRAN
  packages versions
- [`pac_compare_news()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_compare_news.md)
  : Compare NEWS files between specific CRAN packages versions

## Validation Functions

- [`lib_validate()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/lib_validate.md)
  : Validate the local library
- [`lock_validate()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/lock_validate.md)
  : Validate a specific renv lock file
- [`pac_validate()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_validate.md)
  : Validate a specific local package

## Check State of R packages

- [`checked_packages()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/checked_packages.md)
  : Retrieving all R CRAN packages check pages statuses.
- [`pac_checkpage()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_checkpage.md)
  : Retrieving the R CRAN package check page
- [`pac_checkred()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_checkred.md)
  : Checking the R CRAN package check page status
- [`pac_health()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_health.md)
  : CRAN package health state at a specific Date or for a specific
  version
- [`pac_lifeduration()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_lifeduration.md)
  : Package version life duration at specific Date or for a specific
  version
- [`pacs_lifeduration()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pacs_lifeduration.md)
  : Packages life duration for a specific version

## Shiny App Dependencies and Size

- [`app_deps()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/app_deps.md) :
  The shiny app dependencies
- [`app_size()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/app_size.md) :
  Size of the shiny app

## Base Packages

- [`pacs_base()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pacs_base.md)
  : Get base R packages

## Utils Functions

- [`compareVersionsMax()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/compareVersionsMax.md)
  : Maximum version across the vector

- [`compareVersionsMin()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/compareVersionsMin.md)
  : Minimum version across the vector

- [`pac_isin()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_isin.md) :
  Checking if a package is in repositories

- [`pac_islast()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_islast.md)
  : Checking if a package version is the most recent one

- [`pac_last()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/pac_last.md) :
  Getting the most recent package version

- [`dir_size()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/dir_size.md) :
  Size of the package

- [`cran_flavors()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/cran_flavors.md)
  : Retrieving all R CRAN servers flavors

- [`match_flavors()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/match_flavors.md)
  :

  Get all matched CRAN servers to the local `OS`

- [`biocran_repos()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/biocran_repos.md)
  : CRAN and Bioconductor repositories

- [`bio_releases()`](https://polkas.github.io/pacs/reference/bio_releases.md)
  : Retrieving all Bioconductor releases
